description: This file defines the IManageAccountsCallback interface for handling account management events in the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

classes.name: IManageAccountsCallback
classes.description: Interface for callbacks related to account management actions such as selection, deletion, and configuration changes.

methods.name: onSelect
methods.description: Callback invoked when an account is selected.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Callback invoked when an account is deleted.

methods.name: onChangeNotesPath
methods.description: Callback invoked when the notes path for an account is changed.

methods.name: onChangeFileSuffix
methods.description: Callback invoked when the file suffix for an account is changed.
